exposure: Surgical approach (laparoscopical myomectomy (LIM) vs. laparoscopically-assisted myomectomy (LAIM))
cohort: 273 women of reproductive age affected by intramural or subserous myomas (FIGO type 3-6) of 4-14 cm diameter.
finding: Intracapsular myomectomy using a single-layer continuous suturing technique, whether by LIM or LAIM, is a safe and effective procedure for women with myomas, leading to successful wound healing and no uterine ruptures in subsequent pregnancies.
